policy_note: Article numbers are provided only where explicitly verified in the project guide; unknown article numbers are set to null per AGENTS.md honesty rules.

2023/956.citation: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing a carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM)
2023/956.role: Primary CBAM founding regulation defining scope, authorised declarants, certificate surrender, free allocation adjustment, and penalties

2025/2083.role: Omnibus simplification amendments (including small-importer mass threshold exemption and compliance timeline updates)

2025/2546.role: Verification principles and rules for accredited verifiers checking declared embedded emissions

2025/2547.role: Methodology for calculating and monitoring embedded emissions of CBAM goods in the definitive period

2025/2548.role: Rules on CBAM certificate pricing and quarterly/weekly EU ETS allowance average calculation

2025/2620.role: Rules for the free allocation adjustment (SEFA), production-route CBAM benchmarks, and cross-sectoral correction factor application

2025/2621 (as corrected by 2026/1740).citation: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 as corrected by Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740
2025/2621 (as corrected by 2026/1740).role: Default values by CN code and country of origin and proportionate markups applied when actual verified emissions data are unavailable

price_eur_per_tco2e.description: CBAM certificate price in EUR per tonne of CO2e based on EU ETS allowance auction averages

free_allocation_factor_by_year.description: Annual free-allocation factor phasing out from 0.975 (97.5% free / 2.5% payable) in 2026 to 0.0 (100% payable) in 2034

cscf_by_year.description: Cross-Sectoral Correction Factor (CSCF) applied in the SEFA calculation

benchmark_tco2e_per_t.description: CBAM product benchmark (tCO2e per tonne of product) for the installation's production route

default_benchmark_tco2e_per_t.description: CBAM benchmark applicable when default SEE values are used (may differ from actual route benchmark [VERIFY])

default_value_base_tco2e_per_t.description: Base default Specific Embedded Emissions (tCO2e per tonne of product) by CN code and country of origin before markup

default_markup_by_year.description: Proportionate markup added to base default values (10% in 2026, 20% in 2027, 30% from 2028)

verified_see_tco2e_per_t.description: Actual installation Specific Embedded Emissions (tCO2e per tonne of product) determined per CBAM monitoring and verification rules

tonnes_shipped.description: Total mass of imported CBAM-covered goods in tonnes (subject to the 50-tonne annual small-importer mass threshold in 2025/2083)
